artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: OG-pr-3 repair: probe_call reads the request body through _read_body_bounded. A declared Content-Length over 65536 is answered 413 probe_body_too_large before any byte is read; otherwise the body is streamed and the read stops as soon as the running count passes 65536 (chunked bodies are bounded by the same count). An oversized body is answered 413 before the lease is consulted, labelled probe:unarmed (see surprise row NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W149-S1). The refusal order after a within-bound read is unchanged. Committed @adf7f1cfd0 (LOCAL on wk-NFRA_OPLGTW-149). No release, no deploy, no IAM, no SSM parameter, no env key, no Terraform, no change to server.py, audit.py, tools.py or any other app file.

Ten named tests, offline. ac01 to ac08 unchanged in meaning. ac09 (THE READ IS BOUNDED: a streamed 800 KB body of 50 chunks of 16384 bytes is answered 413 after the server pulls at most 6 chunks; a declared Content-Length 5000000 body is answered 413 after at most 1 chunk is pulled; ASGI harness, armed lease) and ac10 (A BODY AT THE LIMIT IS STILL SERVED: a body of exactly 65536 bytes answers 200 and one of 65537 bytes answers 413, each declared and chunked) are new. Committed @adf7f1cfd0 (LOCAL).

One appended row: NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W149-S1 (OBSERVATION, INERT, UNDER_INVESTIGATION): the order's oversized-body 413 is answered before the lease is consulted and audited like every refusal, so it carries the probe:unarmed label rather than the armed probe's order label. Committed @a64913c55c (LOCAL); surprise-row-gate OK (1 new row).
